title: Show HN: Open-Source eInk Bike Computer
summary: An open-source eInk bicycle computer built with ESP32 that connects to ANT+ sensors (speed, cadence, heart rate) for cycling metrics display. The project includes a custom ANT protocol implementation for ESP32 achieved through reverse engineering undocumented registers.
problem_solved: Provides cyclists with a low-cost, customizable, open-source alternative to expensive proprietary bike computers.
why_valuable: Empowers cycling enthusiasts to build, modify, and customize their own bike computer while demonstrating creative use of AI for reverse-engineering wireless protocols.
